QUOTE: `app/hooks/navigation_header.tsx` (`useAppNavigationHeader`) also takes a `hasSearch` flag, but it renders the `Header` component from `components/navigation_header/header.tsx`, not `NavigationHeader`. It has no ref path, so it is not one of the eight files above.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explicitly excludes the hook's renderer of `Header` from `navigation_header/header.tsx` as not being a NavigationHeader renderer. The item also mentions the thread route, which the answer doesn't name, but its list of eight files omits it.
